dreamed.songTitle: Sue (Or in a Season of Crime)
stanza: Sue, I found your note
That you wrote last night
It can't be right
You went with him
Sue, I never dreamed
I'm such a fool
Right from the start
You went with that clown

dreamed.line: Conjecturin' on matters that I ain't never dreamed
stanza: Now, what would you get if you heard my opinion
Conjecturin' on matters that I ain't never dreamed
In all my born days as a white boy from Hickman
Based on the way that the world's been to mе?
Anyone who ever loved
Could look at me and know that I love you
Anyone who ever dreamed
Could look at me and know I dream of you
Knowing I love you, so
Where do your golden rainbows end?
Where do the rainbows end?
Why is this song I sing so sad?
Dreaming the dreams I've dreamed my friend
Dreaming the dreams I've dreamed
Loving the love I love

gleamed.line: And meanwhile above all these Norwegians dancing in the twilight the permanent…
stanza: "Live your life, and if you don't the ground is definitely ready at any moment…
To digest you back into something useful for somebody"
And meanwhile above all these Norwegians dancing in the twilight the permanent…
You used to call me "Neige Éternelle."

redeemed.line: And I need to be redeemed
stanza: Ooh, what I need is a good defense
'Cause I'm feelin' like a criminal
And I need to be redeemed
To the one I've sinned against
Because he's all I ever knew of love
